name: Number
accessibility: A range of two numbers - consider Slider for a bounded range with no need for exact keyboard entry.
Uses the native numeric input semantics so mobile keyboards default to a numeric layout automatically.
Stepper buttons are separately focusable and labeled ("Increase quantity" / "Decrease quantity"), not just plus/minus icons.

source.notes: Rendered snapshot of the selected type/configuration, with State and Appearance and Size captured as crossed properties (State, Appearance, Size) - every combination draws as its own Figma variant. Label, Required, Supporting text, Show supporting text, Error message are bound Text/Boolean properties (Supporting text/Error message are mutually exclusive in the live render, so each was harvested and bound separately rather than sharing one node). Label Placement stays a page-level choice. Native property IDs retain canonical values; anatomy styles and tokens use context.unit. Interaction rules and unseen configurations require authored behavior bindings.
